note: Static cards derived from journeys J1-J30 in docs/INDIA_PUBLIC_SERVICE_DEMAND_RESEARCH.md. Summaries are original orientation text, not procedural guidance. No card has human review. url_check records an automated HTTP check from a non-India machine on 2026-11-27; 'tls_blocked' means the handshake failed from that machine, not that the URL is wrong. Every URL needs a human check before launch.

cards.title: File an RTI request
cards.summary: Ask a public authority for records, such as file notings or reasons recorded for a decision. Central bodies use RTI Online; many states run their own RTI systems.
examples: How do I file an RTI to find out why my application was rejected?
I want the file notings for my rejected certificate
How to ask a government office for information

cards.title: RTI first appeal
cards.summary: If an RTI reply did not arrive in time or was unsatisfactory, a first appeal goes to the First Appellate Authority of the same public authority.
examples: My RTI reply did not come. How do I file the first appeal?
I filed an RTI 40 days ago and got no reply
RTI answer was incomplete, what next?

cards.title: Government complaint closed but not fixed
cards.summary: CPGRAMS is the official channel for grievances about Central government services, including feedback on a grievance that was closed while the problem remains.
cards.scope: Central; states have their own portals
examples: My government complaint was closed without fixing the problem
My pension complaint was marked resolved but payment is still missing
Grievance disposed but nothing changed

cards.title: Ration shop complaint
cards.summary: Complaints about a fair price shop giving less grain, refusing supply or overcharging go to the state food and civil supplies department. NFSA lists state helplines.
examples: Where should I complain about my ration dealer not giving full grain?
The ration shop gave me less rice
Ration dealer is asking for extra money

cards.title: Apply for a new ration card
cards.summary: New ration cards are issued by your state's food department. The NFSA portal links to each state's application system.
examples: How do I apply for a new ration card in my state?
I need a ration card
Ration card application online

cards.title: Add a family member to a ration card
cards.summary: Adding a newborn or other member to a ration card is handled by the state food department's ration card system.
examples: How do I add my newborn to the ration card?
Add my wife's name to ration card
Include child in ration card

cards.title: Correct a ration card
cards.summary: Wrong names, addresses or member details on a ration card are corrected through the state food department.
examples: My ration card has the wrong name. How do I correct it?
Change address on ration card
Spelling mistake in ration card

cards.title: Find and apply for a scholarship
cards.summary: The National Scholarship Portal lists many Central and some state schemes. Other scholarships run on state portals or through the institution.
examples: Which scholarship can I apply for and what documents do I need?
Scholarship for college students
Where do I start a scholarship application?

cards.title: Scholarship rejected, stuck or not paid
cards.summary: A stuck or rejected scholarship can sit with the institute, the state or the scheme ministry. The National Scholarship Portal shows status and has a grievance option.
examples: My scholarship application is rejected. Who must fix it?
Scholarship money not received
NSP application pending at institute

cards.title: Income certificate
cards.summary: Income certificates are issued by state revenue authorities, usually through the state's e-District or service portal or a Common Service Centre.
cards.official_name: National Portal of India (find your state portal)
examples: How do I get an income certificate?
Income certificate apply online
Where to make income proof for scholarship

cards.title: Caste certificate
cards.summary: Caste certificates (SC, ST, OBC) are issued by state revenue authorities through state service portals or offices.
cards.official_name: National Portal of India (find your state portal)
examples: How do I get a caste certificate?
OBC certificate apply
SC certificate for admission

cards.title: Domicile or residence certificate
cards.summary: Domicile and residence certificates are issued by state revenue authorities through state portals or offices.
cards.official_name: National Portal of India (find your state portal)
examples: How do I get a domicile certificate?
Residence certificate apply online
Need native certificate for job

cards.title: Birth registration or birth certificate correction
cards.summary: Births are registered by the local Registrar of Births and Deaths. Late registration and corrections go through the registrar or the Civil Registration System.
examples: How do I register a birth late?
Correct the name on my birth certificate
Birth certificate apply online

cards.title: Death certificate or correction
cards.summary: Death certificates and corrections are handled by the local registrar or municipality, often through the Civil Registration System.
examples: How do I correct a death certificate?
Get death certificate of my father
Wrong date on death certificate

cards.title: Aadhaar name, date of birth or address correction
cards.summary: Aadhaar details are updated through UIDAI, online for some fields and at an Aadhaar centre for others.
examples: My Aadhaar name or date of birth is wrong. What can I do?
Update address in Aadhaar
Aadhaar spelling mistake

cards.title: EPFO / UAN name or date of birth correction
cards.summary: Corrections to EPF member details are requested through the EPFO member portal and approved by the employer and EPFO.
examples: My EPFO UAN name is wrong. How do I fix it?
PF date of birth mismatch
Name mismatch in PF account

cards.title: Register a small business (MSME / Udyam)
cards.summary: Udyam Registration is the official, free registration for micro, small and medium enterprises.
examples: How do I register my small business as an MSME?
Udyam registration
MSME certificate for my shop

cards.title: Do I need GST registration?
cards.summary: Whether a business must register for GST depends on turnover, the type of supply and the state. The GST portal publishes the rules; a tax professional can confirm.
examples: Do I need GST registration for my small business?
GST limit for small shop
Is GST compulsory for online selling?

cards.title: Apply for GST registration
cards.summary: New GST registrations are filed on the GST portal.
examples: How do I apply for GST registration?
Get a GST number
GSTIN application

cards.title: GST registration rejected or clarification asked
cards.summary: Rejections and clarification notices on a GST application are answered on the GST portal before the stated deadline.
examples: Why was my GST registration rejected?
GST officer asked for clarification
Reply to GST registration notice

cards.title: Customer has not paid my small business
cards.summary: Registered micro and small enterprises can file delayed-payment cases against buyers through MSME Samadhaan.
examples: A customer has not paid my small business for months
Can I use MSME Samadhaan for delayed payment?
Company not paying my invoice

cards.title: Find government schemes I might qualify for
cards.summary: myScheme lets you search Central and state schemes by eligibility details. Final eligibility is decided by the scheme owner.
examples: What government schemes might I qualify for?
Schemes for women
Benefits for senior citizens

cards.title: PM-KISAN application or stopped payment
cards.summary: PM-KISAN registration, status and eKYC are on the official portal; land and bank verification sit with state authorities.
examples: How do I apply for PM-KISAN?
PM-KISAN installment stopped
Farmer 2000 rupees not received

cards.title: Register on e-Shram
cards.summary: e-Shram is the national registration for unorganised workers. Registration is free on the portal or at a Common Service Centre.
examples: How do I register on e-Shram?
Shram card benefits
Labour card for daily wage worker

cards.title: Submit a pension life certificate
cards.summary: Pensioners can submit a Digital Life Certificate through Jeevan Pramaan, or in person at the bank or pension office.
examples: How do I submit my pension life certificate?
Jeevan Pramaan online
Life certificate for pension from home

cards.title: Pension stopped or not credited
cards.summary: Central government pension grievances can be raised on the CPENGRAMS pension grievance portal; the bank or pension disbursing office is usually the first contact.
examples: My pension has stopped even though I submitted the life certificate
Pension not credited this month
Complaint about pension delay

cards.title: Street vendor loan (PM SVANidhi)
cards.summary: PM SVANidhi offers working-capital loans to street vendors, applied for through the official portal with the urban local body.
examples: How do I get a street-vendor loan under PM SVANidhi?
Loan for street vendor
Hawker loan scheme

cards.title: FSSAI registration or licence for a food business
cards.summary: Food businesses need FSSAI registration or a licence depending on size and type, applied for on FoSCoS.
examples: Do I need FSSAI registration for my food business?
Food licence for home tiffin service
FSSAI license for restaurant

cards.title: Which department handles my problem?
cards.summary: The National Portal of India links to Central ministries and state portals. When you know the service, its owning department is the first channel; CPGRAMS handles Central grievances.
examples: Which department should I contact about this problem?
Who do I complain to about a government office?
Where do I report a government service problem?

cards.title: Garbage, streetlight, drainage or water complaint
cards.summary: Local civic problems belong to your municipality or panchayat, usually through its own app, portal or ward office. The National Portal links to state and city portals.
cards.official_name: National Portal of India (find your city portal)
examples: How do I complain about garbage not being collected?
Streetlight not working in my street
Unsafe drinking water in my area

cards.title: Passport: new, renewal or reissue
cards.summary: Passports are applied for and renewed through Passport Seva, followed by an appointment at a Passport Seva Kendra or Post Office Passport Seva Kendra.
examples: How do I apply for a new passport?
Renew my passport
Passport appointment booking

cards.title: Driving licence: learner, new or renewal
cards.summary: Learner licences, driving licences and renewals are handled through Sarathi (Parivahan) and your state transport office (RTO).
examples: How do I get a driving licence?
Apply for a learner licence
Renew my driving licence

cards.title: PAN card: new, instant e-PAN or correction
cards.summary: An instant e-PAN using Aadhaar is available on the Income Tax e-filing portal. Physical PAN applications and corrections go through Protean (NSDL) or UTIITSL.
examples: How do I get a PAN card?
Instant e-PAN with Aadhaar
Correct my name on PAN card

cards.title: Voter ID: register, correct or move
cards.summary: New voter registration, corrections and address shifts are filed on the Election Commission's Voters' Service Portal.
examples: How do I apply for a voter ID card?
Change address on voter card
Is my name on the voter list?

cards.title: Free legal help (Legal Services Authority)
cards.summary: Legal Services Authorities give free lawyers and legal advice to eligible people, including women, children, SC/ST members, workers and people below an income limit. Apply to the District Legal Services Authority or through NALSA.
examples: I need a free lawyer for a court case
How can a poor family get legal help?
Where do I get free legal advice?

cards.title: Block a lost or stolen phone
cards.summary: Sanchar Saathi (Department of Telecommunications) lets you block a lost or stolen phone by its IMEI so it cannot be used, and unblock it if found. Report the theft to the police as well.
examples: My phone was stolen, how do I block it?
Lost my mobile in the bus
Block IMEI of stolen phone
